usage: cox stats chair [-h] [--since SINCE] [--json] [--session SESSION]
                       [--work-store-root WORK_STORE_ROOT] [--projects-dir PROJECTS_DIR]
                       [--profile PROFILE]
                       [runs_dir]

positional arguments:
  runs_dir

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --since SINCE         keep only records and transcript lines dated on or after DATE (YYYY-MM-DD)
  --json
  --session SESSION     a Claude session id to count as chair cost, beside those in chair.json
                        (repeatable)
  --work-store-root WORK_STORE_ROOT
  --projects-dir PROJECTS_DIR
  --profile PROFILE     the routing profile naming cartridges_dir (default: ~/.config/agent-
                        tools/profile.yaml or $AGENT_TOOLS_PROFILE)
